title: Boundary flexibility for curvature conditions
summary: We prove a general boundary gluing principle for families of Riemannian metrics with pointwise curvature restrictions on manifolds with possibly non-compact boundary. This includes, as special cases, the classical gluing theorems by Perelman for metrics with positive Ricci curvature and convex singularities and by Gromov-Lawson and Bär-Hanke for metrics with positive scalar curvature and mean convex singularities.
